  Requirement: The PR must pass CI on its head SHA. The orchestration project's deliverables (#7126: shared checks gate with Gate D, single-read poller fixes, `gh_retry` in the guard-block handler, `implement.yml` `env:` conversion with the 18,000-character guard test, plus the fix-cycle-2 security-pass audit tree) are present in the diff, but the aggregate `lint` check fails on head 17e7368c because `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` (CI run 38464517558, `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py::test_template_copies_are_identical` at line 2451) and `tests-release-and-log-analysis` (`tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py`) both require `.claude/settings.json` to be byte-identical to `workflow-templates/.claude/settings.json`. The template registers a new Bash PreToolUse hook that runs `python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py hook` (the diff shows the added block ending the template's hook list, see `workflow-templates/.claude/settings.json:140-149`), while the live `.claude/settings.json` ends its hook list at `.claude/settings.json:130-142` without that registration, and the live `.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py` is absent. This drift came in with the most recent merge of `main` into this branch (sync merges 9cb0f32 and b1f0eb0 from the LAST COMMIT STAT) and is the same blocker all previous autofix rounds (entries 13-25 of the PR comment thread) reported and deferred as sandbox-excluded.
  Expected change site: `.claude/settings.json` (copy `workflow-templates/.claude/settings.json` over byte for byte) and `.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py` (create with the same content as `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py`, present on this ref at line 1-709 per the SEMBLE snippet), committed to the head branch.
  Evidence of absence: `git log` on the head (commit 17e7368c) and the LAST RUN DIFF (which only modified `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py` to add the 9-line reap loop) show no change to `.claude/settings.json` or to `.claude/hooks/`. The CI log tail in `pr_check_runs_context.txt` shows the same failure pattern in both `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` (parity assertion at line 2451, with the added `prepush_affected_tests` block visible only on the template side) and `tests-release-and-log-analysis` (SessionStart registration parity check), and the aggregate `lint` job reports `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator: failure`, `tests-release-and-log-analysis: failure`. The other four CI jobs (`static-checks`, `tests-heal-plan-and-validation`, `tests-promote-stall-and-review`, `orchestrate-poll`) all report `success` on the same head, so the four deliverables in the diff are themselves sound; the missing implementation is the live/template sync, not the deliverables.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
